mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace_vote (id, workspace_id, title, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{title}, #{createdBy}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT v.id, v.workspace_id, w.name AS workspace_name, w.slug AS workspace_slug, v.title, v.created_by, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), u.username) AS creator_name, v.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace_vote_participant p WHERE p.vote_id = v.id AND p.choice = 'AGREE') AS agree_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace_vote_participant p WHERE p.vote_id = v.id AND p.choice = 'DISAGREE') AS disagree_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace_vote_participant p WHERE p.vote_id = v.id AND p.choice IS NULL) AS pending_count, (SELECT p.choice FROM workspace_vote_participant p WHERE p.vote_id = v.id AND p.user_id = #{userId}) AS my_choice FROM workspace_vote v LEFT JOIN sys_workspace w ON w.id = v.workspace_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = v.created_by WHERE v.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY v.created_at DESC

SELECT v.id, v.workspace_id, w.name AS workspace_name, w.slug AS workspace_slug, v.title, v.created_at FROM workspace_vote_participant p JOIN workspace_vote v ON v.id = p.vote_id JOIN sys_workspace w ON w.id = v.workspace_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.choice IS NULL ORDER BY v.created_at DESC

SELECT v.id, v.workspace_id, w.name AS workspace_name, w.slug AS workspace_slug, v.title, v.created_by, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), u.username) AS creator_name, v.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace_vote_participant p WHERE p.vote_id = v.id AND p.choice = 'AGREE') AS agree_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace_vote_participant p WHERE p.vote_id = v.id AND p.choice = 'DISAGREE') AS disagree_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace_vote_participant p WHERE p.vote_id = v.id AND p.choice IS NULL) AS pending_count, (SELECT p.choice FROM workspace_vote_participant p WHERE p.vote_id = v.id AND p.user_id = #{userId}) AS my_choice FROM workspace_vote v LEFT JOIN sys_workspace w ON w.id = v.workspace_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = v.created_by WHERE v.created_by = #{userId} ORDER BY v.created_at DESC LIMIT 12
